items.title: Late Comedian Sam Kinison — with His AI Avatar — Gears Up for Second Act with Buchwald (EXCLUSIVE)
items.excerpt: Talent agency Buchwald has signed the estate of late stand-up Sam Kinison along with an AI avatar of him, powered by the Uare.AI platform, to develop new business opportunities — a posthumous digital-replica deal handled like a living client.

items.title: 'Crazy Rich Asians' producer John Penotti working on global AI certification standard with Qatar's Film Committee
items.excerpt: Speaking at Doha's industry days, producer John Penotti said Qatar's Film Committee has spent the past year building an AI certification process intended to become a globally recognised standard for productions using AI.

items.title: Lemonlight launches AI video production platform
items.excerpt: Lemonlight has launched Hero, an AI production operating system that unifies collaboration across production and whose agent can directly revise content, whether shot traditionally or AI-generated.
items.angle: AI filmmaking platform launch (also covered by No Film School 11-19)

items.title: Does GenAI Belong At Animation Festivals? Annecy, Ottawa, And Manchester Programmers Weigh In
items.excerpt: As Manchester Animation Festival moves to bar genAI entries from 2027, Annecy's Marcel Jean, Ottawa's Chris Robinson and MAF's Steve Henderson explain where each draws the line on AI in film submissions.
items.angle: festival AI rules (saturated angle; programmer comparison)

history_match.title: Manchester Animation Festival Announces 2026 Winners, New AI Policy

items.title: 'The Piano' Animated Short Receives Official 'Human Made Mark' Certification
items.excerpt: Avery Kroll's Tribeca short 'The Piano' is certified with the Human Made Mark, a del Toro-backed initiative certifying that no artists were replaced by generative AI; certified films carry an animated ident and a numbered credit mark.

items.title: David Fincher's openness to AI isn't helping the Cliff Booth AI accusations
items.excerpt: Early viewers and critics accuse Netflix's 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth' of using generative AI in key scenes; Fincher told the LA Times 'I'm not a Luddite, so I don't fear the unknown.' Off-list exception: no allowed-domain outlet covered the AI allegations.
items.angle: genAI use allegation in major studio film

items.title: Christopher Nolan and Guillermo del Toro Break Down 'The Odyssey' Monsters and AI's Limitations with Production VFX Supervisor Andrew Jackson
items.excerpt: At a VES Q&A, Nolan and VFX supervisor Andrew Jackson explain the Cyclops, Scylla and Circe sequences; Nolan stresses the artistry of compositing 'in an age with artificial intelligence looming,' and del Toro says VFX is the craft assailed fastest by AI.

history_match.title: Christopher Nolan Previews DGA's Next Phase of AI Protections: 'It's Down to the Studios'

items.title: Envato's 2nd Annual AI Report Finds Adoption Has Outrun the Rules
items.excerpt: Envato's survey of 1,033 creatives finds 58% use AI daily, 53% of users have put AI on client work without telling the client, and most team creatives have no written AI policy.

items.title: Utopai Studios Opens Beverly Hills Office
items.excerpt: AI-native studio Utopai, behind the animated feature 'The Most Serious Fart' and Antonio Banderas' 'Cortés', opens a Beverly Hills production base and plans about 500 production jobs worldwide next year.

items.title: We Found a Wild AI Video Conspiracy...

items.title: Hudson AI bets on dubbing quality to take K-content abroad
items.excerpt: Hudson AI CEO Shin Hyun-jin said at ICNX 2026 that dubbing costs 10x subtitles and AI can take long-tail K-content abroad; after Amazon's AI-dub backlash, quality decides the market, and Hudson is building an agentic workflow.

items.title: 관객 선택이 바꾸는 조선의 역사와 단원 김홍도… 100% 생성형 AI 인터랙티브 시대극 '위인극장' 베일 벗다

items.title: Can it Eliminate the Flickering? (CorridorKey 2.0)

items.excerpt: No Film School looks at Lemonlight's Hero, an AI production OS that unifies production management and generative AI in one platform. Same story as the Broadcast item — keep only one.
